description: Run one or more raw Gretl command lines. By default this also requires opening the same workflow in the visible Gretl GUI.

commands.description: Gretl command lines to run in order.

displayInGretl.description: Open the generated command script in the visible Gretl GUI. Defaults to true outside CI.

gretlCliPath.description: Optional explicit path to gretlcli or gretlcli.exe.

gretlGuiPath.description: Optional explicit path to gretl or gretl.exe.

guiNewInstance.description: Open a new Gretl GUI instance for the visible script.

keepWorkspace.description: Keep the run workspace so generated artifacts remain available.

requireGui.description: Require the visible Gretl GUI to open for this workflow. Defaults to true outside CI.

safeMode.description: When true, blocks shell-like commands and absolute file writes.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum runtime in seconds. Defaults to 30, max 300.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional directory where run workspaces are created.

name: gretl_run_commands
